page.notes: Doubtful readings: "VIC" (printed V1C; the figure may be a broken I, so [?] was not added in the text but should be checked). The Greek "H᾽ΘIKOYS" begins with a mark over the initial that may be a rough breathing; the Greek after "quasi" (ἤθων ἀ-χονισμὸς) and the Greek after "aut" (ἐς ἄνεμον τὰ ἀσθ-ξαῖα) are read from a small, soft scan and should be checked against the original. "cùm" is printed with a grave accent and is given as "cum". The word "vix" at the end stands alone on the last line, right-aligned, and is part of the running text, so it is not a catchword.
